linesVerbatim: ## Monorepo CI and independent component releases
**Proposed V2 architecture requirement.** OpenSIP may remain a monorepo while
components release independently. Declared component ownership and dependency
metadata select isolated language/component CI lanes; an unrelated change does
not force every language closure to build. The selector must fail safe when
ownership or dependency impact is ambiguous.
Each selected component lane builds, tests, packages, signs, attests, emits an
SBOM/license inventory, and qualifies its self-contained closure on the relevant
manifest-declared platforms. It also runs its language-native capability/parity,
behavior, performance, runtime-UX, packaging-adapter, and conformance gates.
Separate lanes cover:
- the shared distribution core/semantic host/pure-core contracts;
- common control protocol and unchanged opaque provider data planes;
- semantic-authority and D9/fate integration;
- deterministic lock/dependency/compatibility resolution;
- clean-machine authoritative offline closure; and
- aggregate convenience/air-gap bundle qualification.
Independent releases do not require separate repositories and do not create
lockstep versions. A release selects independently qualified compatible bytes
through signed metadata and per-surface matrices.
DR-121 and DR-G16 require acceptance tests for correct lane selection, omitted
dependency/owner detection, per-lane exact release evidence, and cross-component
integration. CI provider, YAML, repository path filters, caches, commands, and
implementation tooling remain reserved for the later blueprint.

File 02, file 08, and gate-harness-naming.v3 are re-verified at the remeasurement block whose standing is LIVE. Live COORD pin is recorded only at that LIVE block. selector.authority: The ownership record is the only impact authority. It includes: unit→owner maps, shared-surface→consumer-component edges, multiComponentSharedLaneSelection, roleApplicability (custodied DR-118 component→role map), validated platform sets, and the previous/current comparison basis. Dependency edges from the DR-103 manifest/index are an input to that record, not a second authority. There is no separate uncustodied trigger table. Path filters/YAML/CI vendor config are not authority.

closedLaneUniverse.componentLanes: Exactly one component lane per component identity in the comparison-basis union. A current-declaration-only enumeration is never authoritative.
closedLaneUniverse.note: The universe is closed. A lane that is preview-not-required still exists as a slot.
closedLaneUniverse.construction: Universe = component lanes for every identity in the comparison-basis union, plus SL-1..SL-6. Deletion of a component identity does not remove its lane from the universe of the change that deleted it.

ownershipRecord.standing: AUTHORITATIVE committed design record. Not CI YAML. Not a path-filter table as authority.
ownershipRecord.unitIdentity: A repository source unit under committed tree custody (presence + bytes). Concrete path encoding is reserved for the later blueprint; the unit is the thing whose add/delete/rename/byte-change is observable.

declaration.cardinality: Each unit maps to exactly one owner.

ownershipRecord.custody: The record is committed with a digest. A digest change is change-class C-OWNERSHIP-RECORD.
ownershipRecord.completeness: Every first-slice source unit MUST appear exactly once. Missing, duplicate, or conflicting declarations are AMBIGUOUS.
ownershipRecord.selfChange: If the ownership record digest changed, the change set includes the union of units it previously claimed and units it now claims.

sharedSurfaceConsumers.standing: Part of the ownership record. Same custody digest, completeness, and self-change expansion as unit maps.
sharedSurfaceConsumers.edge: shared-surface ownerId CORE|PROTOCOL|SEMANTIC|LOCK|OFFLINE|BUNDLE → the set of component identities that consume that surface.
sharedSurfaceConsumers.completeness: Every shared-surface ownerId that exists in the closed universe MUST list its consumer set (may be empty only if no component consumes it, which is itself a recorded fact).
sharedSurfaceConsumers.propagation: Selecting a shared surface ALSO selects every consumer component lane. If the consumer set is missing or conflicting, the change is AMBIGUOUS.

multiComponentSharedLaneSelection.standing: Part of the ownership record. Same custody digest, completeness, and self-change as unit maps and sharedSurfaceConsumers.
multiComponentSharedLaneSelection.predicate: If the selected component-lane set has cardinality >= 2, also select SL-2, SL-3, and SL-4.
multiComponentSharedLaneSelection.notATriggerTable: This is a named predicate inside the custodied ownership record, not a second uncustodied authority.
multiComponentSharedLaneSelection.completeness: The predicate MUST be present on every committed ownership record. Its threshold is fixed at selected component-lane cardinality >= 2. Absence, a different threshold, or a conflicting copy is AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY. It MUST NOT silently under-select SL-2/SL-3/SL-4.

roleApplicability.standing: Part of the ownership record. Same custody digest, completeness, and self-change as unit maps.
roleApplicability.source: Product-selected DR-118 role list. Not read from the component manifest.
roleApplicability.rule: Every comparison-basis component identity MUST have an effectiveRoleAxis that is exactly one of: (1) that identity's nonempty applicable-role set drawn from the product-selected DR-118 list; (2) the singleton {ROLELESS-NA} when this record carries a valid explicit ROLELESS-NA sentinel; (3) the singleton {MISSING} when roleApplicability is missing, empty, conflicting, or out-of-list. ROLELESS-NA is a lawful sentinel, not empty roleApplicability, and is not C-MISSING-ROLE-APPLICABILITY.
roleApplicability.completeness: Missing, empty, conflicting, or out-of-list applicability is AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY with role=MISSING. It MUST NOT erase the component from fixtureDomainBasis. A valid ROLELESS-NA declaration is complete.
roleApplicability.previewFirstSlice: TypeScript is the only preview first-slice role. Other DR-118 roles keep named deferred cells, not omissions.

validatedPlatformSets.standing: Part of the ownership record. Same custody digest, completeness, previous/current comparison, and self-change as unit maps.
validatedPlatformSets.source: Each comparison-basis component identity's platform set is read from that identity's DR-103 component manifest, then validated against the D-002 slice-1 vocabulary. D-002 names four OS/architecture targets: macOS-arm64, macOS-x86_64, Linux-x86_64, Linux-arm64. Windows is absent until that platform enters. A token that names only an OS (linux or macOS) without architecture is invalid.
validatedPlatformSets.validation: A platform token not in the four-member D-002 vocabulary, an OS-only token, an empty set, or a conflicting pair of sets is invalid.
validatedPlatformSets.completeness: Every comparison-basis component identity MUST have a validated nonempty D-002 platform set, or the missing/invalid case is recorded as platform=MISSING. Missing/empty/invalid is AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY and MUST NOT erase the identity from fixtureDomainBasis.
validatedPlatformSets.previousCurrent: previous/current comparison is of the custodied validated sets inside the ownership record, not a second live re-read of the manifest at selector time. Manifest-to-record inequality is AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY.
validatedPlatformSets.selfChange: A change to a validated platform set expands the change set to that identity's cells.
validatedPlatformSets.digest: The validated sets are inside the single ownership-record digest. They are not a separately uncustodied harness input.

changeSet.changedUnits: The normalized union of add/delete/rename/byte-change units between the whole-candidate baseline and the current candidate tree (or the aggregate union of per-commit change sets when that discipline is used).
changeSet.rename: Modeled as delete(old unitIdentity) plus add(new unitIdentity). Both must resolve.
changeSet.delete: A unit present previously and absent now remains a changed unit and must still resolve against the previous claim or be AMBIGUOUS.
changeSet.previousCommittedTree: The whole-candidate baseline: the integration-target merge-base tree of the candidate, digest-pinned at execution. The immediate first parent of a non-merge head is not the whole-candidate baseline. If every commit is instead authoritative, require the complete ordered set of per-commit decisions and their aggregate union.
changeSet.changeSetDigest: Canonical digest binding the current candidate tree/commit identity, the authoritative comparison baseline identity, and the normalized add/delete/rename/byte-change set. Required in selectorDecision.inputsDigest.

steps: Apply ownership-record self-change expansion if the record digest moved.
Resolve each changed unit through the current ownership record.

Classify as AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY on any of: 0 owners; ownerId outside comparison-basis universe; missing component declaration; incomplete/invalid universe; missing/altered/conflicting multiComponentSharedLaneSelection; a comparison-basis identity with a missing, empty, or invalid platform set; or missing/empty/conflicting/out-of-list roleApplicability. This step is the single enumeration of REFUSE-only conditions. More than one owner AND independently complete and valid universe AND no REFUSE-only condition → AMBIGUOUS-CONFLICT and MUST SELECT-ENTIRE-UNIVERSE (ambiguity=conflict-universe). Any REFUSE-only condition dominates C-MULTI-OWNER. conflict-refuse is not a lawful current output.
Seed selected lanes: component owner → that component lane; CORE→SL-1; PROTOCOL→SL-2; SEMANTIC→SL-3; LOCK→SL-4; OFFLINE→SL-5; BUNDLE→SL-6.

Fixpoint: repeat reverse-dependency closure, sharedSurfaceConsumers propagation, and ownership-record.multiComponentSharedLaneSelection until the selected set does not grow. Order of the expansions does not matter because all run to the same fixpoint.

ambiguityPolicy.previewDefault: SELECT-ENTIRE-UNIVERSE is MUST when the only ambiguity is C-MULTI-OWNER on an independently complete and valid universe. REFUSE is MUST when any REFUSE-only condition is present. Implementations MUST NOT choose REFUSE for a complete conflict.
ambiguityPolicy.law: REFUSE runs no lanes and emits a typed refusal. SELECT-ENTIRE-UNIVERSE selects every lane in the comparison-basis universe. Any AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY condition as classified in the algorithm's step 3 makes SELECT-ENTIRE-UNIVERSE unlawful; REFUSE is required. Under-selection is a failed successor. Complete C-MULTI-OWNER is not a lawful REFUSE.
ambiguityPolicy.completeConflict: MUST SELECT-ENTIRE-UNIVERSE (ambiguity=conflict-universe). REFUSE of a complete conflict is a failed successor.
ambiguityPolicy.combinedWithRefuseOnly: Any REFUSE-only condition as classified in step 3 dominates C-MULTI-OWNER. Combined outcome is refuse-only.

selectorDecision: perLaneExplanation[] derived only from ownership record (including sharedSurfaceConsumers and multiComponentSharedLaneSelection), DR-103 dependency edges, changeSetDigest, and ambiguityPolicy. There is no trigger table.
ambiguity = none | refuse-only | conflict-universe. conflict-refuse is HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED (v5 four-value repair); it is not a lawful current producing branch.

inputsDigest covering the single ownership-record digest (unit maps + sharedSurfaceConsumers + multiComponentSharedLaneSelection + roleApplicability + validated platform sets + comparison basis), the DR-103 dependency-edge digest, changeSetDigest, and the pre-mutation fixtureDomainBasis digest
selectorDecisionDigest joined to every signed lane emission and to aggregate/release evidence

algorithm.inputCompleteness: Ownership unit maps, sharedSurfaceConsumers, multiComponentSharedLaneSelection, roleApplicability, validatedPlatformSets, comparison basis, and DR-103 dependency edges are on one closed authority roster. Each has schema/custody, previous/current self-change expansion, and missing/conflicting → AMBIGUOUS. A missing or altered multiComponentSharedLaneSelection is AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY. A missing/empty/invalid platform set or missing/empty/conflicting/out-of-list roleApplicability is AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY. A valid ROLELESS-NA sentinel is complete, not missing. Omitted dependency, consumer, predicate, role-axis, or platform-set edges cannot silently skip a lane. The pre-mutation fixtureDomainBasis digest is a required selector/harness input.

selector.failSafe: Fail-safe is over-selection or typed refusal, never under-selection. An affected omitted lane has no waiver (live DR-G16).
selector.mustNot: Path filters, CI vendor config, or cache keys cannot be the authority that decides impact. Those are reserved implementation of a declared mapping.

comparisonBasis.baseline: The whole-candidate baseline tree plus the validated union of previous and current component identities and ownership claims.
comparisonBasis.law: The component-lane universe is computed on this basis and MUST NOT shrink under the reviewed change. Any AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY condition as classified in the algorithm's step 3 makes SELECT-ENTIRE-UNIVERSE unavailable; the only lawful ambiguity action is REFUSE.

must: qualify the self-contained closure on the relevant manifest-declared platforms
run language-native capability/parity, behavior, performance, runtime-UX, packaging-adapter, and conformance gates
componentLane.platforms: Relevant platforms are those declared in the component manifest. D-002 vocabulary for slice 1. Windows absent until that platform enters.
componentLane.rolelessNa: ROLELESS-NA cells do not run unconditional language-quality gates. Disposition is qualification-neutral named cells.

sharedLanes.name: shared distribution core/semantic host/pure-core contracts
sharedLanes.note: Required whenever those contracts change or the selector is ambiguous about them.

sharedLanes.name: common control protocol and unchanged opaque provider data planes
sharedLanes.note: Consumes DR-102. Does not translate provider frames.

sharedLanes.name: semantic-authority and D9/fate integration
sharedLanes.note: Does not mint D9 codes. Executes against the applied D9 surface.

sharedLanes.name: deterministic lock/dependency/compatibility resolution
sharedLanes.note: Consumes DR-103/DR-107/DR-111. Window evaluation waits on DR-111.

sharedLanes.name: clean-machine authoritative offline closure
sharedLanes.note: NAMED. Not required for architecture preview. D-002 defers authoritative sealed closure (DR-106/109/113 wholly). The lane is not deleted from the architecture.

sharedLanes.name: aggregate convenience/air-gap bundle qualification
sharedLanes.note: A bundle may qualify a selection; it cannot be the only route (DR-127). Preview does not require the bundle lane to ship.

rules: Independent releases do not require separate repositories.
Independent releases do not create lockstep versions.
A release selects independently qualified compatible bytes through signed metadata and per-surface matrices.
Component release identity and core release identity are independently versioned. A required same-version train is a failed successor.
A bundle may qualify a selection; it cannot be the only release route.

discriminatingCases.name: component-new / core-unchanged
discriminatingCases.requires: A component can emit a new independently versioned release while the supported core identity is unchanged.

discriminatingCases.name: core-new / component-unchanged
discriminatingCases.requires: Core can emit a new independently versioned release while a supported component identity is unchanged.

discriminatingCases.name: independent rollback/coexistence
discriminatingCases.requires: Either identity can roll back or coexist without forcing the other identity to the same version.

discriminatingCases.name: non-bundle route
discriminatingCases.requires: A qualifying path exists that is not the aggregate convenience/air-gap bundle. SL-6 cannot be the only route.

object: releaseIdentity {componentId, componentVersion, coreVersion} with independently assigned versions
signed per-lane closure emissions for every selected lane; blocked-on-ride standing may occupy the slot only for SL-5 and SL-6
evidence.lockstepFail: A same-version release train that cannot emit both IR-1 and IR-2 fails this contract even if it emits a selector record and lane artifacts.

rides.windowEvaluation: DR-111. This artifact does not mint compatibility windows or numbers.
rides.antiLockstepHostileCases: DR-127. This artifact names IR-1..IR-4; it does not author the hostile dual-channel goldens.

independentRelease.standing: DESIGN-ANSWERED. Execution of cases that need window numbers is INACTIVE until DR-111. Hostile dual-channel cases ride DR-127. OBL-6 is not claimed QUALIFIED.
independentRelease.coverageLaw: Every IR-1..IR-4 cell MUST exist. A failed or INACTIVE cell is explicit NON-PASS, not a silent skip. Omission of a case is a failed successor. Window evaluation still rides DR-111.

dimensions: language-role (effectiveRoleAxis per identity: nonempty applicable product-selected DR-118 roles, or {ROLELESS-NA}, or {MISSING}; NOT read from the component manifest; preview first-slice role is TypeScript only)
platform (ownershipRecord.validatedPlatformSets: manifest-sourced, D-002-validated; effectivePlatformAxis is the nonempty validated set or {MISSING}; Windows absent until that platform enters)

changeClasses.means: bytes change only under component A
bytes change under B; A declares a dependency on B
a changed unit has zero owners
a changed unit has more than one owner
a changed unit has an ownerId outside the comparison-basis universe
a changed unit's component declaration is missing
comparison-basis universe construction is incomplete or invalid
aggregate release selection over independently versioned identities
a comparison-basis identity has a missing, empty, or invalid platform set
a comparison-basis identity has missing, empty, conflicting, or out-of-list roleApplicability

corpus.coverageLaw: The closed domain is fixtureDomainBasis (pre-mutation) plus deferredSlots. Every cell in that exact domain MUST have a result. Omission of a cell is a failed successor. Hostile mutation MUST NOT shrink the domain. A D-002-deferred language-role or platform keeps a named DEFERRED-OUT-OF-PREVIEW-DOMAIN cell.

fixtureDomainBasis.computedWhen: BEFORE any hostile mutation of declarations, ownership, roles, or platforms.
fixtureDomainBasis.members: Every comparison-basis component identity × that identity's effectiveRoleAxis × that identity's effectivePlatformAxis × every changeClass in this corpus. Because both axes are defined to be nonempty, the product cannot collapse by an empty factor.
fixtureDomainBasis.nonShrinkLaw: Hostile deletion, withholding, or alteration of a component declaration, role applicability, or platform applicability MUST NOT remove a cell from this basis. The cell is retained and the selector/harness MUST emit typed REFUSE or explicit NON-PASS for that cell.
fixtureDomainBasis.missingMetadata: Missing/empty/invalid platform set on a comparison-basis identity retains named C-MISSING-PLATFORM-METADATA cells with platform=MISSING sentinel and forces typed REFUSE/NON-PASS via selector step 3. Missing/empty/conflicting/out-of-list roleApplicability retains named C-MISSING-ROLE-APPLICABILITY cells with role=MISSING sentinel and forces typed REFUSE/NON-PASS. A valid ROLELESS-NA identity retains named cells with role=ROLELESS-NA (not C-MISSING-ROLE-APPLICABILITY) across its effectivePlatformAxis and every changeClass. A missing component declaration cannot erase role or platform cells.

deferredSlots.reason: Windows is absent until that platform enters the slice (D-002). Disposition is DEFERRED-OUT-OF-PREVIEW-DOMAIN: slot-complete and qualification-neutral. It is not blocked-on-ride, not INACTIVE, and not NON-PASS. Not an omission.
deferredSlots.notAValidatedToken: DEF-WIN is a deferredSlots sentinel, not a member of ownershipRecord.validatedPlatformSets. It is not an OS-only validated platform token. validatedPlatformSets still rejects OS-only tokens.

fixtureDomainBasis.digestRule: A closed digest of the pre-mutation basis MUST appear on every corpus run. A harness that computes the domain after mutation is a failed successor.
fixtureDomainBasis.roleApplicabilityBasis: Custodied, digest-bound component→role map from DR-118, carried in ownershipRecord.roleApplicability. effectiveRoleAxis is MUST-nonempty for every comparison-basis component identity. The fixtureDomainBasis digest MUST NOT bless an empty-factor omission.
fixtureDomainBasis.effectiveRoleAxis: For every comparison-basis component identity the language-role axis is exactly one of: (1) that identity's nonempty applicable product-selected DR-118 role set; (2) the singleton {ROLELESS-NA} when the ownership record carries a valid explicit ROLELESS-NA sentinel; (3) the singleton {MISSING} when roleApplicability is missing, empty, conflicting, or out-of-list. The axis is never the empty set. ROLELESS-NA is not classified C-MISSING-ROLE-APPLICABILITY.
fixtureDomainBasis.effectivePlatformAxis: For every comparison-basis component identity the platform axis is that identity's nonempty ownershipRecord.validatedPlatformSets value, or the singleton {MISSING} when the set is missing, empty, or invalid.
fixtureDomainBasis.rolelessNaQualification: A valid ROLELESS-NA identity keeps named cells across effectivePlatformAxis and every changeClass. Those cells are DEFERRED-OUT-OF-PREVIEW-DOMAIN / qualification-neutral against the component lane's unconditional language-quality gates (DR-118). They are not omitted and they are not automatic language-gate NON-PASS. Preview first-slice TypeScript gates apply only to identities whose effectiveRoleAxis includes TypeScript.

requiredResults.selectedLaneExplanation: Required for every selected lane. Derived from selectorDecision.perLaneExplanation.
requiredResults.skippedLaneProof: Required for every skipped lane. Proof is membership in skipped[] plus the explanation that no ownership, reverse-dependency, sharedSurfaceConsumers, multiComponentSharedLaneSelection, or ambiguityPolicy rule selected it. The word trigger is not a rule.
requiredResults.signedPerLaneClosureEvidence: Required for every selected lane: signed closure bytes/declarations for that lane. A named blocked-on-ride standing with owner is a lawful slot occupant only for preview-not-required lanes SL-5 and SL-6. For selected preview-required component lanes and SL-1..SL-4, blocked-on-ride is explicit NON-PASS. See resultSuccessVersusSlotCompleteness.

SL-3.whenSelected: required semantic/D9 integration result; does not mint D9

SL-4.whenSelected: required lock/compatibility result; window evaluation rides DR-111

SL-5.whenSelected: required offline-closure result or blocked-on DR-106/DR-G06
SL-5.standing: NAMED. Preview-not-required. Slot MUST exist. D-002 defers authoritative sealed closure. The lane is not deleted.

SL-6.whenSelected: required bundle-qualification result or blocked-on DR-127
SL-6.standing: NAMED. Preview-not-required. Slot MUST exist. Cannot be the only release route.

requiredResults.aggregateReleaseSelection: Required whenever changeClass includes C-AGGREGATE-RELEASE or a discriminating IR-* case is claimed. Joins independently versioned identities to the selectorDecision.
requiredResults.resultSuccessVersusSlotCompleteness: Slot completeness (a result or skipped-proof exists) is not result success. For selected preview-required component lanes and SL-1..SL-4, blocked-on-ride is an explicit NON-PASS. It preserves the slot and prevents G16 qualification and independent-release evidence completion. Preview-not-required/blocked substitution is lawful only for named D-002-deferred lanes SL-5 and SL-6.

classes.name: correct lane selection
classes.requires: C-A-ONLY selects A's lane and does not force unrelated language closures. Skipped-lane proofs exist for every unselected component lane and unselected SL-*.

classes.name: omitted dependency detection
classes.requires: C-B-VIA-DEP with B omitted from a hostile selector input fails safe (selects A and B) or REFUSE. Silent omit is a failed successor.

classes.name: omitted owner detection
classes.requires: C-MISSING-OWNER, C-OWNER-OUTSIDE-UNIVERSE, C-MISSING-COMPONENT-DECLARATION, C-INCOMPLETE-UNIVERSE, C-PREDICATE-MISSING, C-MISSING-PLATFORM-METADATA, and C-MISSING-ROLE-APPLICABILITY are REFUSE only (selectorDecision.ambiguity = refuse-only), including when they co-occur with C-MULTI-OWNER (REFUSE-only dominates). C-MULTI-OWNER on an independently complete and valid universe, with no REFUSE-only condition, MUST be conflict-universe (SELECT-ENTIRE-UNIVERSE). conflict-refuse is not a lawful current output. They do not default to no-op.

classes.name: per-lane signed closure evidence
classes.requires: Each selected lane emits signedPerLaneClosureEvidence joined to selectorDecisionDigest. blocked-on-ride and INACTIVE ride cells are explicit NON-PASS. They preserve the slot and prevent G16 qualification and independent-release evidence completion.

classes.name: cross-component protocol/semantic/lock
classes.requires: Shared lanes SL-2/SL-3/SL-4 produce results when selected because the ownership-record.multiComponentSharedLaneSelection predicate fired (selected component-lane cardinality >= 2) or a PROTOCOL/SEMANTIC/LOCK surface was seeded. There is no second trigger authority.

classes.name: shared-core slot
classes.requires: SL-1 always has either a result or a skipped-lane proof. It cannot disappear from the result map.

classes.name: offline-closure slot
classes.requires: SL-5 always has a result slot. Preview-not-required / blocked-on DR-106 is lawful; omission is not.

classes.name: bundle slot
classes.requires: SL-6 always has a result slot. Preview-not-required / blocked-on DR-127 is lawful; using it as the only release route is not.

classes.name: skipped-lane proof
classes.requires: Every skipped lane in every corpus cell carries skippedLaneProof.

classes.name: component × language × platform matrix
classes.requires: The corpus exists across those dimensions. Deferred roles/platforms keep named cells.

classes.name: aggregate release selection
classes.requires: C-AGGREGATE-RELEASE emits aggregateSelection joined to independently versioned identities and to the same selectorDecisionDigest.

classes.name: lockstep discrimination
classes.requires: A same-version train that cannot emit IR-1 and IR-2 fails. Independent-release evidence is not satisfiable by lockstep.

classes.name: selector decision binding
classes.requires: Every signed lane emission and the aggregate/release evidence carry the selectorDecisionDigest of the decision they are offered under. inputsDigest reproduces over the recorded ownership-record digest, DR-103 dependency-edge digest, changeSetDigest, AND the pre-mutation fixtureDomainBasis digest. Omitting any join, including the fixtureDomainBasis digest, is a failed successor even if every lane has a result.

classes.name: pre-mutation fixture-domain digest
classes.requires: Every corpus run emits the closed pre-mutation fixtureDomainBasis digest. The executed FDB cell set MUST reconcile exactly against the basis that digest commits to. deferredSlots are additional named cells outside that digest; coverageLaw still requires a result for each. They are not surplus against G16-14 and they are not FDB members. Any FDB shortfall, post-mutation domain, or omitted digest is a failed successor.

g16Tests.execution: Condition 4. Existing here does not QUALIFY.

dependencies.consequence: Component-lane package/sign/attest/SBOM steps consume DR-120. This artifact does not redesign them.
Independent release selection uses matrices; it does not evaluate windows this row does not own.
The lane runs those gates; numbers are not decided here.
SL-6 cannot become the only release route.

dependencies.feature: Ownership-record custody bytes (unit maps + sharedSurfaceConsumers + multiComponentSharedLaneSelection + roleApplicability + validatedPlatformSets + comparison basis) and DR-103 dependency-edge custody bytes
dependencies.ridesOn: DR-103 manifest/index plus a committed ownership record (this row)
dependencies.consequence: There is no separate trigger-table artifact. Validated platform sets are custody bytes of the ownership record (manifest-sourced, D-002-validated, previous/current compared). The consumer relation, the multi-component shared-lane predicate, roleApplicability, and validatedPlatformSets live inside the ownership record. A missing/conflicting predicate, role axis, or platform set is REFUSE-only.

dependencies.feature: Ownership-record roleApplicability / effectiveRoleAxis (ROLELESS-NA and MISSING sentinels)
dependencies.consequence: The language-role axis is never empty. ROLELESS-NA is a lawful sentinel axis, not C-MISSING-ROLE-APPLICABILITY. Missing/invalid applicability uses role=MISSING and REFUSE-only. Numeric thresholds remain UNDECIDED on DR-118.

whatThisDoesNotDo: Does not SATISFY DR-121 until independently reviewed and recorded by a later D-000 MF-6.
Does not choose a CI vendor, YAML, path filter, cache, or command.
Does not execute DR-G16 or mark QUALIFIED.
Does not delete the authoritative-offline lane from the architecture; it marks it preview-unrequired.
Does not require separate repositories or lockstep versions.
Does not mint DR-111 compatibility windows or numbers.
Does not author DR-127 hostile dual-channel goldens.
